symptom: my BME280 throws an error about no device at the configured address. The default Adafruit address is 0x77, and a scan shows 0x77 present, so it should just work — but it doesn't.

files.bme.py:
from board import *
from adafruit_bme280 import basic as adafruit_bme280
i2c = I2C(scl, sda)
bme = adafruit_bme280.Adafruit_BME280_I2C(i2c)
print(bme.temperature)

gold.diagnosis: i2cdetect shows the device present at 0x77 (119) — the Adafruit_BME280_I2C default IS 0x77, so the address is correct and the default constructor should work. The real bug is that SDA and SCL are swapped in the I2C() call (I2C(scl, sda) instead of I2C(scl=GPIO3, sda=GPIO2)). With the lines swapped the controller can't address any device even though i2cdetect (which uses the kernel's correctly-wired bus) sees it. This is a wiring fault — STOP editing the code and check the SDA/SCL wiring and pull-ups.
